scope: Reconcile current public FreeCAD, OCCT, and CAD Exchanger evidence into the DWG/DXF 3D support plan, distinguishing open-source codec/kernel capability, stock FreeCAD integration, and separately licensed modeler routes.

method.kind: Primary project documentation/source and public maintainer issue review, plus local plan/source crosswalk
method.evidenceBoundary: Project pages and source are implementation/feature statements; FreeCAD documentation is archived and cannot establish a current release contract. Mutable main-branch source is discovery evidence only. Vendor format matrices and FreeCAD issue discussion do not prove acceptance of a specific DWG/DXF/SAT/SAB payload. Existing hash-pinned local FreeCAD 1.1.3 runs remain limited to their exact recorded tuples.

observed: The OCCT project identifies the open-source core as LGPL-2.1 with a special exception.
The separate OCCT-Components project classifies ACIS SAT/SAB import-export and DXF import-export as commercial extensions and directs users to a purchase path for full components.
doesNotEstablish: A free/open-source OCCT build with the ACIS or DXF commercial components enabled
Acceptance or semantic correctness for any particular ACIS version, DWG AcDs record, or libdxfrw output
evidence.planUse: Do not assume stock OCCT or FreeCAD's OCCT dependency provides an ACIS reader. Keep licensed ACIS import as a separately authorized external route; it is not an open-source peer implementation, default dependency, or per-slice requirement.

evidence.topic: FreeCAD importer split and documentation freshness
observed: The FreeCAD documentation repository is archived (read-only since 2026-04-01); its Draft DXF page describes separate C++ and optional legacy Python importers, lists 3D faces only under the legacy importer, and says 3D ACIS/SAT solids cannot currently be read.

The current FreeCAD source has a C++ DXF importer and a separate DWG adapter that converts to DXF before calling the DXF open/insert route; importer settings and post-processing are part of the consumer profile.
In issue #18454, a FreeCAD maintainer states the standard DXF importer cannot read the proprietary ACIS blob and closes the report as not planned.
doesNotEstablish: A current version-wide guarantee for either importer from archived documentation or mutable main source
That every explicit 3D DXF entity is unsupported or supported
ACIS semantics, B-rep validity, or ACDSDATA owner/history behavior
evidence.planUse: Keep every FreeCAD result keyed by pinned release/revision, OS/architecture, importer implementation/effective mode, operation, version, and entity. Native Linux/Windows S8.9.5 proves converter installation/handoff only unless final-document geometry independently passes. If FreeCAD entity support is claimed, run the selected importer and inspect final-document shape/topology rather than parser counts or published tables alone.

observed: CAD Exchanger's current format matrix advertises B-rep read for DWG and DXF and read/write for standalone SAT/SAB.

The FreeCAD add-on states it invokes the vendor's ExchangerConv process to convert supported input to Open CASCADE BREP, then loads that BREP into FreeCAD; the vendor application is commercial and separately licensed.
doesNotEstablish: Exact ASM 230/ACIS-218 payload compatibility, DWG AcDs linkage, history lifecycle, or source-handle/owner preservation
A current run, geometry metrics, or any native Linux/Windows FreeCAD result for this repository's payloads
evidence.planUse: Retain CAD Exchanger only as an optional licensed external reader/consumer candidate. If authorized and later selected, use the same exact hashed DWG, DXF, and extracted SAB inputs; record product/license/runtime, route, importer operation, repairs/omissions, and independently expected geometry metrics. Never substitute this result for open-source support or for the stock FreeCAD importer profile.

nextActions: Continue local format work independently of optional FreeCAD, OCCT commercial components, and vendor licenses.

Keep S8.9.5 native Linux/Windows qualification scoped to installed converter discovery, exact argv/status, valid output, and selected importer handoff; do not infer ACIS or 3DFACE geometry support from that gate.

Keep modeler semantics behind a source-native known-size witness, exact carrier/owner linkage, an independent reader, and separately measured B-rep metrics; treat CAD Exchanger only as a licensed optional route.

Before a FreeCAD entity claim, run a pinned runtime against the actual final output with the selected importer mode and assert final document objects/topology; archived docs and mutable main source are not runtime evidence.
Keep J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
